actions_per_minute.instruction: Estimate the player's average number of actions per minute in this StarCraft II replay.
actions_per_minute.field_description: league_index is the ranked league: 1 Bronze, 2 Silver, 3 Gold, 4 Platinum, 5 Diamond, 6 Master, 7 GrandMaster, 8 Professional. age_years is the player's age in years. hours_played_per_week and total_hours_played are self-reported weekly and lifetime StarCraft II playtime, both in hours.
